import * as T from 'three';
const PHOTO='https://img.dpm.org.cn/Uploads/image/2026/04/30/3-wEzDjKTBc313.jpg';
const ROLES=new Set(['r73-glazed-pier','r73-side-screen','r73-portal-head','r73-central-glaze-band','r73-side-glaze-band','r73-side-screen-base']);
const near=(a,b)=>Number.isFinite(a)&&Math.abs(a-b)<1e-10;
const writable=(o,k)=>Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(o,k)?.writable===true;
function canonical(o){return o.visible===true&&o.matrixAutoUpdate===true&&o.matrixWorldAutoUpdate===true&&o.scale.equals(new T.Vector3(1,1,1))&&!o.rotation.x&&!o.rotation.y&&!o.rotation.z;}
function equalGeometry(a,b){return a?.isBufferGeometry&&a.drawRange.start===0&&a.drawRange.count===Infinity&&JSON.stringify(a.groups)===JSON.stringify(b.groups)&&Object.keys(a.attributes).sort().join()===Object.keys(b.attributes).sort().join()&&Object.entries(b.attributes).every(([k,v])=>{const q=a.attributes[k];return q.isBufferAttribute===true&&!q.isInterleavedBufferAttribute&&q.itemSize===v.itemSize&&q.normalized===v.normalized&&q.array.constructor===v.array.constructor&&q.array.length===v.array.length&&q.array.every((x,i)=>x===v.array[i]);})&&!!a.index===!!b.index&&(!b.index||a.index.itemSize===b.index.itemSize&&a.index.normalized===b.index.normalized&&a.index.array.constructor===b.index.array.constructor&&a.index.count===b.index.count&&a.index.array.every((x,i)=>x===b.index.array[i]));}
function originalDrawState(m){return m.visible===true&&m.side===T.FrontSide&&m.colorWrite===true&&m.depthWrite===true&&m.depthTest===true&&m.wireframe===false&&m.transparent===false&&m.opacity===1&&m.alphaTest===0&&m.blending===T.NormalBlending&&m.vertexColors===false&&m.flatShading===false&&m.clippingPlanes===null&&m.clipIntersection===false&&m.clipShadows===false&&m.emissive.getHex()===0&&['map','alphaMap','aoMap','lightMap','emissiveMap','bumpMap','normalMap','displacementMap','roughnessMap','metalnessMap','envMap'].every(k=>m[k]===null);}
function expected(p){const rows=[],half=p.centralWidth/2,outer=p.totalWidth/2,portal=p.opening.width/2,hd=p.depth/2;const add=(role,x0,x1,y0,y1,z0,z1,material,field)=>rows.push({role,x0,x1,y0,y1,z0,z1,material:'r73-yangxin-'+material,field});for(const s of[-1,1]){const a=s<0?-half:portal,b=s<0?-portal:half,c=s<0?-outer:half,d=s<0?-half:outer;add('r73-glazed-pier',a,b,p.floor,p.bodyTop,-hd,hd,'red-field','pier');add('r73-side-screen',c,d,0,p.sideTop,-hd,hd,'red-field','side');add('r73-side-screen-base',c,d,0,.36,-hd-.08,hd+.08,'stone','base');for(const y of[p.sideTop-.4,p.sideTop-.12])add('r73-side-glaze-band',c,d,y,y+.12,-hd-.045,-hd,'green-glaze','band');}add('r73-portal-head',-portal,portal,p.opening.height,p.bodyTop,-hd,hd,'red-field','head');for(const y of[p.bodyTop-.8,p.bodyTop-.4])add('r73-central-glaze-band',-half,half,y,y+.22,-hd-.07,-hd,'green-glaze','band');return rows;}
function sliceFaces(source,front){const ids=[];for(let i=0;i<source.index.count;i+=3){const tri=[0,1,2].map(j=>source.index.getX(i+j)),isFront=tri.every(j=>source.attributes.normal.getZ(j)===-1);if(isFront===front)ids.push(...tri);}if(ids.length!==(front?6:30))throw Error('Exact two-triangle front source required');const geometry=new T.BufferGeometry();try{for(const[k,a]of Object.entries(source.attributes)){const out=new a.array.constructor(ids.length*a.itemSize);ids.forEach((id,i)=>{for(let j=0;j<a.itemSize;j++)out[i*a.itemSize+j]=a.array[id*a.itemSize+j]});geometry.setAttribute(k,new T.BufferAttribute(out,a.itemSize,a.normalized));}return geometry;}catch(error){geometry.dispose();throw error;}}
const palette={red:'#87352e',green:'#2c6254',dark:'#183f39',gold:'#c5a35b',light:'#d3bc78',stone:'#b2a382'};
function rosette(c,x,y,rx,ry){c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.scale(rx,ry);c.fillStyle=palette.green;c.strokeStyle=palette.gold;c.lineWidth=.055;c.beginPath();for(let n=0;n<=144;n++){const t=n*Math.PI*2/144,r=1+.09*Math.cos(t*8),px=Math.cos(t)*r,py=Math.sin(t)*r;n?c.lineTo(px,py):c.moveTo(px,py)}c.closePath();c.fill();c.stroke();for(let n=0;n<8;n++){const t=n*Math.PI/4;c.save();c.rotate(t);c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,-.48,.17,.33,0,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();c.restore();}c.fillStyle=palette.gold;c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,.19,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();c.restore();}
function flower(c,x,y,r){c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.scale(r,r);c.strokeStyle=palette.gold;c.lineWidth=.09;for(let n=0;n<8;n++){c.save();c.rotate(n*Math.PI/4);c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,-.46,.18,.32,0,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();c.restore();}c.fillStyle=palette.gold;c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,.18,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();c.restore();}
function medallion(c,x,y,rx,ry,horizontal){c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.scale(rx,ry);c.fillStyle=palette.green;c.strokeStyle=palette.gold;c.lineWidth=.045;c.beginPath();for(let n=0;n<=144;n++){const t=n*Math.PI*2/144,r=1+.07*Math.cos(t*8),px=Math.cos(t)*r,py=Math.sin(t)*r;n?c.lineTo(px,py):c.moveTo(px,py)}c.closePath();c.fill();c.stroke();c.restore();const positions=[[0,-.6],[-.34,-.30],[.34,-.30],[0,0],[-.34,.30],[.34,.30],[0,.6]];for(const[u,v]of positions)flower(c,x+(horizontal?v:u)*rx,y+(horizontal?u:v)*ry,Math.min(rx,ry)*.24);}
function tendril(c,x,y,sx,sy){c.save();c.translate(x,y);c.scale(sx,sy);c.strokeStyle=palette.gold;c.lineWidth=.045;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,1);c.bezierCurveTo(.05,.3,.36,.05,1,0);c.bezierCurveTo(.78,.42,.45,.65,0,1);c.stroke();for(let n=0;n<4;n++){const u=.18+n*.18;c.beginPath();c.ellipse(u,1-u,.17,.07,-.8,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();}c.restore();}
function field(c,w,h,side){c.fillStyle=palette.red;c.fillRect(0,0,w,h);const x=w*.055,y=h*.13,W=w*.89,H=h*.74;c.strokeStyle=palette.gold;c.lineWidth=w*.035;c.strokeRect(x,y,W,H);c.strokeStyle=palette.green;c.lineWidth=w*.012;c.strokeRect(x+w*.028,y+h*.014,W-w*.056,H-h*.028);const size=Math.min(w*.29,h*.20);for(const[sx,sy]of[[1,1],[-1,1],[1,-1],[-1,-1]]){const xx=sx>0?x+w*.035:x+W-w*.035,yy=sy>0?y+h*.025:y+H-h*.025;tendril(c,xx,yy,size*sx,size*sy);}const cx=w*.5,cy=h*.5,rx=side?w*.28:w*.27,ry=side?h*.16:h*.18;medallion(c,cx,cy,rx,ry,side);c.fillStyle=palette.green;c.fillRect(0,h*.91,w,h*.09);c.strokeStyle=palette.gold;c.lineWidth=2;for(let i=0;i<8;i++)c.strokeRect(i*w/8+2,h*.93,w/8-4,h*.045);}
function band(c,w,h){c.fillStyle=palette.green;c.fillRect(0,0,w,h);c.strokeStyle=palette.gold;c.lineWidth=3;c.strokeRect(2,3,w-4,h-6);c.lineWidth=2;c.strokeRect(w*.25,h*.18,w*.50,h*.64);c.strokeRect(w*.27,h*.30,w*.46,h*.40);for(const s of[-1,1]){for(const t of[.055,.13]){const x=s<0?w*t:w*(1-t);c.strokeRect(x-w*.025,h*.16,w*.05,h*.68);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x,h*.25);c.lineTo(x+w*.016,h*.5);c.lineTo(x,h*.75);c.lineTo(x-w*.016,h*.5);c.closePath();c.stroke();}const x=s<0?w*.21:w*.79;for(let n=0;n<3;n++){const q=x+s*n*w*.012;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(q,h*.24);c.lineTo(q+s*w*.016,h*.5);c.lineTo(q,h*.76);c.stroke();}}}

function head(c,w,h){c.fillStyle=palette.red;c.fillRect(0,0,w,h);c.fillStyle=palette.green;c.fillRect(0,0,w,h*.44);c.strokeStyle=palette.gold;c.lineWidth=3;c.strokeRect(2,2,w-4,h*.44);for(let i=0;i<4;i++){c.beginPath();for(let n=0;n<6;n++){const t=n*Math.PI/3,x=w*(i+.5)/4+Math.cos(t)*w*.045,y=h*.76+Math.sin(t)*h*.08;n?c.lineTo(x,y):c.moveTo(x,y)}c.closePath();c.stroke();}}
function base(c,w,h){c.fillStyle=palette.stone;c.fillRect(0,0,w,h);for(const[y,H]of[[.06,.16],[.38,.22],[.79,.15]]){c.fillStyle=palette.green;c.fillRect(0,h*y,w,h*H);c.strokeStyle=palette.gold;c.lineWidth=3;c.strokeRect(0,h*y,w,h*H);}for(let i=0;i<10;i++)rosette(c,(i+.5)*w/10,h*.49,w*.029,h*.10);}
function material(kit,key,w,h,draw,fieldName){const canvas=typeof document==='undefined'?null:document.createElement('canvas');if(canvas){canvas.width=w;canvas.height=h;}const context=canvas?.getContext('2d');if(context)draw(context,w,h);const map=context?new T.CanvasTexture(canvas):null;if(map){map.name='yangxin-front-'+key+'-fit';map.colorSpace=T.SRGBColorSpace;map.anisotropy=4;}const m=new T.MeshStandardMaterial({name:'yangxin-front-'+key+'-surface-fit',map,color:map?0xffffff:key==='band'?0x286e62:key==='base'?0xc2b9a4:0x872d2b,roughness:.58,metalness:0});m.userData={source:PHOTO,field:fieldName,representation:'FLAT_TEXTURED_SOURCE_FACE_NOT_SCULPTURAL_DEPTH',exactCarving:false,textureBaseRGBA8Bytes:map?w*h*4:0};m.addEventListener('dispose',()=>map?.dispose());kit.owned.push(m);return m;}
/** No new rendered surface, collider, walkable, movement scope or support. */
export function applyYangxinGlazedFront(kit,f,p){
 if(kit.root.name!=='west-six'||!canonical(kit.root)||kit.root.parent!==null||kit.root.position.lengthSq()||f.parent!==kit.root||!canonical(f)||f.name!=='养心门'||!near(f.position.x,109)||f.position.y||!near(f.position.z,251.8)||p?.id!=='yangxin-glazed-entrance-photo-fit-r73'||p.x!==109||p.z!==251.8||p.centralWidth!==8||p.totalWidth!==16.2||p.depth!==1.1||p.bodyTop!==5.5||p.sideTop!==4.2||p.floor!==.12||p.opening.width!==3.2||p.opening.height!==3.7||f.userData.profile!==p||!Object.isExtensible(f.userData)||Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(f.userData,'yangxinGlazedFront')||!Object.isExtensible(f.userData.structure)||Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(f.userData.structure,'yangxinGlazedFront'))throw Error('Exact canonical Yangxin glazed front host required');
 const references=new Map();kit.root.traverse(m=>{if(m.isMesh)references.set(m.geometry,(references.get(m.geometry)??0)+1)});
 const selected=f.children.filter(m=>ROLES.has(m.userData.role)),rows=expected(p),used=new Set();if(selected.length!==13)throw Error('Yangxin requires exactly13 original face-bearing boxes');
 for(const r of rows){const m=selected.find(m=>!used.has(m)&&m.userData.role===r.role&&near(m.position.x,(r.x0+r.x1)/2)&&near(m.position.y,(r.y0+r.y1)/2)&&near(m.position.z,(r.z0+r.z1)/2));const ref=new T.BoxGeometry(r.x1-r.x0,r.y1-r.y0,r.z1-r.z0);const originals=kit.owned.filter(m=>m.name===r.material),finish={'r73-yangxin-red-field':[0x872d2b,.72],'r73-yangxin-green-glaze':[0x286e62,.35],'r73-yangxin-stone':[0xc2b9a4,.9]}[r.material];let valid=false;try{valid=originals.length===1&&m?.material===originals[0]&&m.material.color?.getHex()===finish[0]&&m.material.roughness===finish[1]&&m.material.metalness===0&&originalDrawState(m.material)&&references.get(m.geometry)===1&&m?.isMesh&&m.name===r.role&&canonical(m)&&m.children.length===0&&writable(m,'geometry')&&m.material?.name===r.material&&kit.owned.includes(m.material)&&m.material.visible!==false&&m.material.opacity===1&&equalGeometry(m.geometry,ref);}finally{ref.dispose();}if(!valid)throw Error('Yangxin original source changed: '+r.role);used.add(m);r.mesh=m;}
 const ownedStart=kit.owned.length,staged=[];
 try{
  const mats={pier:material(kit,'pier',256,512,(c,w,h)=>field(c,w,h,false),'vertical-flower-medallion'),side:material(kit,'side',512,512,(c,w,h)=>field(c,w,h,true),'horizontal-flower-medallion'),head:material(kit,'head',512,128,head,'portal-head-four-hexagonal-rims'),band:material(kit,'band',512,128,band,'layered-glaze-band'),base:material(kit,'base',512,128,base,'side-base-fitted-bands')};
  for(const r of rows){const row={...r,front:null,rest:null,added:null};staged.push(row);row.front=sliceFaces(r.mesh.geometry,true);row.rest=sliceFaces(r.mesh.geometry,false);const m=new T.Mesh(row.front,mats[r.field]);m.position.copy(r.mesh.position);m.quaternion.copy(r.mesh.quaternion);m.scale.copy(r.mesh.scale);m.castShadow=r.mesh.castShadow;m.receiveShadow=r.mesh.receiveShadow;m.name='yangxin-existing-front-'+r.role;m.userData={yangxinGlazedFrontFace:true,originalRole:r.role,source:PHOTO,scope:'EXACT_EXISTING_FRONT_TRIANGLES',representation:'SIMPLIFIED_COLOUR_PATTERN_NOT_RELIEF_GEOMETRY'};row.added=m;}
  const metadata={source:PHOTO,scope:'THREE_PART_FRONT_SURFACES_ONLY',wholeGateAccepted:false,sourceFaceMeshes:13,sourceTriangles:26,geometry:'EXACT_ORIGINAL_SURFACE_MULTISET_UNCHANGED',physics:'EXACT_ORIGINAL_RECORDS_UNCHANGED_NOT_NEWLY_CERTIFIED',supersedesOnly:'R73 plain front surface finish, not inherited fitted dimensions/accepted:false',unverified:['sculptural depth and fine carving','historical gold-leaf versus painted material','survey dimensions','rear surfaces','full inner wood screen','roof beasts/lions/lamps/barriers','unknown court wall joins','GPU pixels/performance']};
  // Commit only after every allocation/guard succeeds. Arbitrary throwing event
  // or dispose callbacks during commit are outside the atomicity guarantee.
  for(const r of staged){const old=r.mesh.geometry;r.mesh.geometry=r.rest;f.add(r.added);old.dispose();}f.userData.yangxinGlazedFront=metadata;f.userData.structure.yangxinGlazedFront=metadata;return metadata;
 }catch(error){for(const r of staged){r.front?.dispose();r.rest?.dispose();}for(const m of kit.owned.slice(ownedStart))m.dispose();kit.owned.length=ownedStart;throw error;}
}
